in_sanskrit.name: शिवनन्दन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शिवतत्वम् अनन्तम् (Shivatattvam Anantam) - The endless grace of Shiva

in_hindi.name: शिवनन्दन
in_hindi.meaning: शिवका आनन्द (Shivaka Anand) - The joy of Shiva
in_hindi.long_meaning: शिव के साथ रहने वाला अनन्द (Shiv ke saath rahane vala Anand) - The joy that comes from being with Shiva

in_tamil.name: சிவநந்தன்
in_tamil.meaning: சிவனிடம் விழிந்தன் (Civanidam Vizinthan) - The one who abides in Shiva's abode
in_tamil.long_meaning: சிவனிடம் அவர்களிடம் உபவாஸ்தோம் (Civanidam Avarkalidam Ubavasthom) - Living in the abode of Shiva and being devoted to them

in_telugu.name: శిబనన్దన
in_telugu.meaning: శివదేశద్యేశ్యోదేశ్ (Shivadheshadyeshwyo) - The one who is the lord of Shiva and the God of Gods
in_telugu.long_meaning: శివదేశద్యేశ్యోదేశ్ పరమాశీ���� лоోద్యే (Shivadheshadyeshwyo Paramashiloolade) - The supreme lord who is the God of all Gods and the deity of Shiva

in_marathi.name: Shivnandan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivnandan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shivnandan is a compound name, Shiv meaning God and Nandan meaning pleasure or delight. The name Shivnandan signifies the God of Gods, the one who delights in the divine. This name is a source of immense spiritual power and strength.
